subtitle: Daily word & logic puzzles
promotionalText: Find your daily favorites. Explore word and logic puzzles, keep your streak, and share results without giving the answers away.
description:
A little pause. A good puzzle.

Alford Daily brings 32 word and logic games together in one collection. Follow an alternating number path, find a word connection, grow an anagram or trace words through a field of letters. Discover the games you want to return to.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Choose today's puzzle or explore Practice. Each game explains its rules and gives feedback as you play. Daily and Practice results stay separate.

MAKE IT A DAILY RITUAL
New daily selections arrive at midnight Central Time. Keep local progress and records, use a clue when you need one, and come back for another challenge. Prepared collections are finite; content schedules may evolve.

SHARE THE MOMENT IT CLICKS
Share a result without revealing the answer. Result details reflect your actual play and assistance.

ON IPHONE
The app bundles its games for offline play, with native navigation, local records and optional reminders. Browser and iPhone records are stored separately; account-based cross-device sync is not included.

By Cursed Toaster Studios. Creator credits remain available in each game.
